entregas.como: Tasks done each week. Discarded tasks (duplicates, will not do) do not count.

regularidad.como: How much deliveries change from one week to the next against their average, over the last 8 weeks. The lower, the more predictable.

ciclo.pregunta: How long does a task take once started?
ciclo.como: Days from when a task enters in progress until it is done. Shown as the lead time in which almost everything started is done: 85% of the tasks in the last 4 weeks.

total.pregunta: How long does the requester wait?
total.como: Days from when a task is created until it is done. The time in which almost everything is done: 85% of the tasks in the last 4 weeks.

espera.pregunta: How long is a task stopped?
espera.como: Share of lead time that tasks spend in waiting statuses in Jira (review, testing or the Blocked status). Last 4 weeks.

edad.como: Tasks in progress that have already taken longer than the lead time in which the team finishes almost everything it starts (85% of tasks).

wip.pregunta: How many things do we carry at once?
wip.como: Tasks started and not done at the end of each week. With the export it is an approximation; with the API or weekly snapshots it is exact.

fiabilidad.pregunta: Do we deliver what we commit to?
fiabilidad.como: What was done against what was in the sprint at the start.

arrastradas.pregunta: How much moves to the next sprint?
arrastradas.como: Share of tasks done in the last 8 weeks that went through more than one sprint.

errores.como: Share of work done in the last 8 weeks that is bugs.

retrabajo.como: Share of tasks done in the last 8 weeks that went back to a status they had already been through. Returns after a block do not count.

reparto.como: Share of work done in the last 8 weeks by type: stories, bugs, tasks and other.

pendiente.pregunta: Does more come in than goes out?
pendiente.como: Tasks not started at the end of each week, and tasks coming in against tasks going out.

estimacion.como: Relation between estimated points and real lead time over the last 12 weeks. 1 is a perfect relation; below 0.2 points do not predict.

velocidad.pregunta: How many points do we finish?
velocidad.como: Points of the tasks done each week. Useful to compare the team with itself, never with other teams.

primera.pregunta: How long until something new gets attention?
primera.como: Hours from when a task is created until its first response. The time in which almost everything gets attention: 85% of the tasks created in the last 4 weeks.

agent_readiness.pregunta: Is the work described so that an agent could do it?
agent_readiness.como: Share of tickets created in the last 12 weeks that meet at least 4 of the 5 criteria of the rubric: description with content, acceptance criteria, bounded scope, references and no open dependencies.
